US Launches Seventh Consecutive Night of Strikes on Iran

US Central Command conducted strikes beginning at 19:00 GMT Friday, using "fighter aircraft, aerial drones and warships" targeting Iran's "surveillance sites, military logistics infrastructure, underground weapons storage, and maritime capabilities." Locations included Jask, Sirik, Bushehr, Bandar Abbas, Qeshm Island, Ahvaz, and Yazd.

Casualties: Iranian state media reported at least three people killed and eight wounded in attacks on Hormozgan province.

Iranian response: Major-General Mohsen Rezaei, adviser to Iran's supreme leader, warned that "Iran will no longer limit itself to retaliatory, like-for-like responses … and no political border will be safe" if strikes continue. The IRGC claimed strikes on US assets in Bahrain, Jordan and Kuwait.

Regional impact: Kuwait's Ministry of Electricity, Water and Renewable Energy reported Iran struck a power and water plant, damaging "electricity generation units" and starting a fire. The US State Department advised Americans to reconsider regional travel due to "complex" security with potential for "unforeseen escalation."

Dispute over targets: Tehran accuses Washington of targeting civilian infrastructure, citing damaged bridges and railway lines; the US characterises operations as degrading military capabilities.
